newsitem.title: INDIA: Foreign buyers drive Delhi shares higher.
newsitem.headline: Foreign buyers drive Delhi shares higher.

text.p: Strong buying by foreign institutional investors offset early losses and drove share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange to a higher close on Tuesday, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 5.53 points higher at 914.86 points. The index had dropped to 906.27 in early trade.
"Sizeable buying by foreign investors in blue-chip companies reversed the early downward trend," said B.K. Nagpal of brokers B.B. Portfolios.
Reliance Industries closed 0.15 rupee lower at 363.75 rupees. The share had slipped to 361.60 in afternoon trade before foreign buying pushed it higher, brokers said.
State Bank of India ended 1.05 rupees higher at 355.45.
